items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: I don't exactly remember... I never did know it. They all used to hang out around.

ctx.x: I don't exactly remember. What did I tell you? They all used to hang out around at 25. But as far as for knowing his residence number or anything, I never did know it. They all used to hang out around.
I was going to ask, somebody told me that McCurdy, that Shorty McCurdy played that high society the first time, but you don't think that.
Well, I'm giving to you the way I got. They said that was the voice and that's why the variation came from.
